lines.beaver_en: Hello. What seems to be the problem?
lines.learner: 감기에 걸린 것 같아요. 기침이 나요.
lines.en: I think I caught a cold. I have a cough.
lines.roman: gamgie geollin geot gatayo. gichimi nayo.

lines.beaver_en: Since when have you been coughing?
lines.learner: 사흘 전부터요. 어제보다 오늘 더 심해요.
lines.en: Since three days ago. It's worse today than yesterday.
lines.roman: saheul jeonbuteoyo. eojeboda oneul deo simhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a fever too?
lines.learner: 네, 열이 조금 있는 것 같아요.
lines.en: Yes, I think I have a slight fever.
lines.roman: ne, yeori jogeum inneun geot gatayo.

lines.en: I have a headache and sneeze a lot too.
My head hurts more at night than in the morning.

lines.beaver_en: Have you been hurt recently, by any chance?

lines.en: Yes, my mother is also unwell these days.

lines.beaver: 어머니한테서 옮은 것 같네요. 목 좀 볼게요.
lines.beaver_en: Seems you caught it from her. Let me see your throat.
lines.beaver_roman: eomeonihanteseo olmeun geot ganneyo. mok jom bolgeyo.
lines.learner: 네. 목도 조금 부은 것 같아요.
lines.en: Okay. I think my throat is a bit swollen too.
lines.roman: ne. mokdo jogeum bueun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: It's a cold. Take the medicine for three days.
lines.en: I hope I get better soon.

lines.beaver_en: Drink lots of water and get plenty of rest.
